items.title: Zcash Crossed $1,000 Two Weeks After Grayscale’s ETF Launched. Is Privacy the New Institutional Trade?

items.title: Hunter Biden (and His Laptop) Enter the Cryptosphere With New Meme Coin
items.summary: The son of former President  Joe Biden  is launching a meme coin that takes aim at his family’s nemesis,  Donald Trump.  Yes,  Hunter Biden’s  laptop will live on.  Biden’s token will trade under the ticker, $LAPTOP, and launch Sept. 9 on Base, a digital ledger built by  Coinbase Global  the largest U.S. crypto exchange, people familiar with the matter said.
